evolutionary_history.what_changes: No fossil chronospecies precedes or follows this point, so there is no temporal species delta. Relative to the 10 µm tier floor the onset wavelength lengthens by 2.84 µm and k_c falls from 2π/10µm to 2π/12.84µm.

equations.schnakenberg_u: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + a - u + u^2 v
equations.schnakenberg_v: dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + b - u^2 v
equations.onset_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (Dv f_u + Du g_v) / (2 Du Dv)

boundary_conditions.colony_animation: radial front, optical density zero outside the front; full field on the last frame

parameters.not_slot_182: slot 182 used alpha_scale 1.31, beta_offset 0.25, int_a 12, int_b 4, int_c 48; those values are not used here

empirical_claims: Turing (1952) and Schnakenberg (1979) supply the instability and the kinetics.
Adams, Wieser and Yu (1998) and Clutterbuck (1969) describe conidial pigment genes; they do not state a 13 µm Turing wavelength.
The 12.84 µm length is the slot's detail-scale assignment (1.284e-05 m), not a length read off the colony photograph.
The public-domain mutant colony is a spiral at colony scale. The animation conditions a weak cellular carrier on that measured optical density.
